notes: All 24 confirmed intents are covered by 13 test methods across 4 test files. Test files already existed from a previous iteration and were verified to be comprehensive and correct. Domain tests use parameterized TestCases to cover all valid types (Classroom, Auditorium, Laboratory) and all invalid dimension scenarios (zero and negative for height, width, length). Application tests mock the repository and verify service behavior for valid input, domain validation failures, and repository exceptions. Infrastructure tests mock the DbContext and verify AddAsync behavior, SaveChanges calls, and exception propagation. Presentation tests mock the service and verify HTTP response types (201 Created, 400 BadRequest, 500 ProblemHttpResult) for all scenarios.
